video_title: Muggsy Bogues on Michael Jordan, NBA Playoff Battles & the Toughest Era of Basketball | Cousins

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the old-school NBA locker room culture
quotes.excerpt: These guys get up, light a cigarette, grab a beer. That's the old NBA right there.
quotes.quote: I'm sitting right next to Mo, Tariq Abdul-Wahad, and these guys get up, light a cigarette, grab a beer. That's the old NBA right there.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on joining the Raptors to play with Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady
quotes.excerpt: You two was the main reason why I decided to come. All I needed was finishers.

text_blocks.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
text_blocks.text: I'm so proud of both of you guys. Seeing you guys when I first got to Toronto, I had no idea that I was going to be coming to Toronto till Butch Carter, who was our coach back then, came and recruited me and Dell Curry. It was on the down end of my career at the time, but I knew of you guys. You two was the main reason why I decided to come. All I needed was finishers. Guys who love to run up and down the floor, who gets up and I can throw the ball where I want in the air and y'all going to catch it and be able to do something special with it.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: We tell the story all the time about how important the vets were for us at a young age. I came in at 18, and for me, when you come in out of high school, you don't know anything about this game. There's so much you have to juggle.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the professional approach of veteran players
quotes.excerpt: We were suited down, Kevin Willis and all. We suited down and we came professionally.
quotes.quote: We were suited down, Kevin Willis and all. We were suited down and we came professionally, because that was the experience that we had in the league. We wanted to give that to you guys.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the importance of point guard play
quotes.excerpt: I was always taught by Mr. Leon Howard who taught me and Reggie Williams the importance of that position.
quotes.quote: I was always taught by Mr. Leon Howard who taught me and Reggie Williams the importance of that position. I knew that it starts with the point guard. Point guard is the one that puts everybody in situations and runs the team to the extension of the coach.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on his high school basketball teammates in Baltimore
quotes.excerpt: Reggie Williams, the David Wingate, the Reggie Lewis, may Reggie rest in peace.
quotes.quote: Being around the players that I played with, the Reggie Williams, the David Wingate, the Reggie Lewis, may Reggie rest in peace. Being with that type of group, and Coach Wade understood what I was and what I was capable of doing.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on winning the gold medal in 1986
quotes.excerpt: Myself, the David Robinson and the Kenny Smith, we beat USSR, which is Russia, a bonus in them.
quotes.quote: We won it in '86, to where we went ahead and myself, the David Robinson and the Kenny Smith, we beat USSR, which is Russia, a bonus in them. And getting that and being the one that led that team, it really was a treat.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the 'Muggsy Rule' for dribbling
quotes.excerpt: If you so happen to get by him and you look one time and don't see him, you might want to pick the ball up.
quotes.quote: The Muggsy rule was, you're dribbling up the ball the court, if you so happen to get by him and you look one time and don't see him, you might want to pick the ball up, because he's somewhere.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on Mark Price's passing ability
quotes.excerpt: Mark Price was a guy that I like to help a lot. He was one you couldn't leave.
quotes.quote: Mark Price was a guy that I like to help a lot. He was one you couldn't leave not one minute. You just couldn't leave him one minute.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on Fat Lever's versatility
quotes.excerpt: Fat Lever was something special. He was the original triple-double guy when he first started out.
quotes.quote: Fat Lever was something special. He was the original triple-double guy when he first started out. He don't get the respect that he deserve, because Fat Lever was something special.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on Reggie Lewis coming off the bench
quotes.excerpt: Reggie Lewis came off the bench, believe it or not. Reggie Lewis came off the bench for us.
quotes.quote: Reggie Lewis came off the bench, believe it or not. Reggie Lewis came off the bench for us, and you know, we went 59 and 0 those two years that I was there at Dunbar.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the talent level of his Dunbar high school team
quotes.excerpt: We had 11 guys get Division 1 scholarships, which was unheard of at that time.
quotes.quote: We had 11 guys get Division 1 scholarships, which was unheard of at that time. We had Tim Dawson, he was only 6'7", he went to Miami University.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on playing against Michael Jordan and the 1995 Bulls
quotes.excerpt: This is before they had to hurt Muggsy. That's the series I was playing I was hurting that series.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: What was it like playing against that Bulls team and also obviously MJ when he was there?

text_blocks.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
text_blocks.text: This is before they had to hurt Muggsy. That's the series I was playing I was hurting that series. I wasn't even supposed to play in that series. I had surgery right after the series was over where I missed the next entire season because I got bone on bone. I got hurt a couple of weeks before the regular season was about to end against the Atlanta Hawks.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the 1995 playoff series against the Orlando Magic
quotes.excerpt: The ref held his whistle. They wanted to see MJ going and play that next level.
quotes.quote: We still should have won that series. The ref they held their whistle. They wanted to see MJ going and play that next level which was Orlando. And you know we had battles with Orlando with Penny and Shaq and them. It was probably two to two out of that four-game series that we played.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the iconic photo with Michael Jordan
quotes.excerpt: They called an illegal defense on Zo for standing there and I was pissed with Zo too.
quotes.quote: They called an illegal defense on Zo for standing there and I was pissed with Zo too for even coming over a little bit because MJ thought he had me. Yeah, yeah talking trash and of course you know I like boy you know you ain't getting that thing off.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the trash-talking culture of his era
quotes.excerpt: It comes back from the blacktop, how we grew up. That's how you got who you are.
quotes.quote: That's how you know it comes back from the blacktop, how we grew up. That's how you got who you are in terms of being able to come back and we all left it on the court.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on his first start in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think they had Tim Hardaway because I was again I had surgery and I couldn't really truly walk.
quotes.quote: I think they had Tim Hardaway because I was again I had surgery and I couldn't really truly walk. If you look at some of the scenes especially the scenes at the end where we all walked to touch the ball, I'm just trying to get there. I'm just barely trying to get over there so I don't hurt my knee.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on Michael Jordan's haircut during a film shoot
quotes.excerpt: MJ decided he needed a haircut. So we in the trailer and he let this Caucasian guy who never cut an African American guy hair before.
quotes.quote: One morning we supposed to have this shoot and MJ decided he needed a haircut. So we in the trailer and he let this Caucasian guy who never cut an African American guy hair before cut his hair. He gave him like a bowl cut so we had to shut the shoot down that morning and they had to bring another guy from LA to revive him to give him a better cut.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the star-studded pickup games in Los Angeles
quotes.excerpt: Everybody and their mama came to the play, you know the Reggie Millers and Magic and I mean everybody that lived in LA.
quotes.quote: Everybody and their mama came to the play, you know the Reggie Millers and Magic and I mean everybody that lived in LA because they had a big old like a big tent, air conditioning. MJ had his weight room, he had a little driving range where he can work on his golf and everything. And I think at the same time Shaq was doing Shazam, he was doing this movie and they were making fun of that because he just had a little basketball court out in the parking lot.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on his chemistry with teammates
quotes.excerpt: I felt that with pretty much all the guys because we all had this understanding of who we were.
quotes.quote: I felt that with pretty much all the guys because we all had this understanding of who we were in terms of what we brought to the table. Dell and I played 11 years together. Out of my 14 years we played 11 years together. One in nine in Charlotte and two in Toronto. So being able to be with him so long we developed such a chemistry with amongst ourselves on and off the court.

quotes.speaker: Muggsy Bogues
quotes.summary_phrase: Muggsy Bogues on the shooting ability of Dell Curry
quotes.excerpt: I don't think everybody understands how good of a shooter Dell Curry was.
quotes.quote: I don't think everybody understands how good of a shooter Dell Curry was. What people are seeing now that was a version of that prior to. You got to see that. Please, I mean Dell he was just such an accurate sharp shooter. He had the range, a flick of a wrist, barely jump over a newspaper.
